Answer format: Type.Method — path, one per line
The name is merged across layers. I need callers of `store.Store.CreateMemo` specifically.

q11.
v1.APIV1Service.CreateMemo — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go

`store.Store.CreateMemo` has exactly one direct caller: `APIV1Service.CreateMemo`, the API-layer handler in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (defined at line 70).

(Note: the earlier `CreateMemoComment` and the generated gRPC stubs call the sibling `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` handler, not `Store.CreateMemo` directly.)
